row.title: COST-PROBE-4: resource discovery reads REST lists; the analytics GraphQL API has none
row.body: deploy/cost-probe.mjs asked the GraphQL analytics API for workers, D1, KV and R2 lists, a field that does not exist, so the daily cost guard failed and its later steps (criticality tick, record) were skipped. Discovery now lists each kind over REST; a kind the token cannot list is null (unmeasured) and files no drift item.
